investigations.summary: PSMDB Replica 6.x/7.x/8.x on clients 3.8.0-3.10.0 (15 lanes): the same 8 tests as night 115 failed again (PMM-T2738-T2740 and PMM-T2788-T2792, 'pmm-admin: error: unexpected argument update'). Their fix, pmm-qa#1815, is still open, so this night ran main without it. No new cause.

3.9.0 · PXC 8.4: setup failed at 'Run workload' (sysbench prepare still running after 60 attempts). That one GitHub-hosted runner was slow at every step: docker pull took 15m21s (31 s on a sibling), PXC image prepare 393 s, the whole setup 11m40s. The other 4 PXC 8.4 lanes finished setup in about 1.5 min. Re-running only that job passed: setup 1m38s, 12 passed, 5 version-gated skips.

client 3.8.1 (#1501): wait-for-gh-run-completion.sh got one HTTP 502 from api.github.com at 01:31:14 and exited (curl -f, no retry). The Jenkins post action then ran aws-staging-stop on the PMM Server while the dispatched GH run 45298813191 was still testing it. That run's first test got ECONNREFUSED at 01:31:30, and all 143 tests in its 5 shards failed. Reproduced on a VM: one 502 makes main exit 22. The fix (curl --retry, at most 300 s) survives it.
